cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是BBC世界服务的《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: Hello, I'm Oliver Conway.
cues.zh: 大家好，我是奥利弗·康韦。

cues.en: This edition is published in the early hours of Sunday, the 16th of August.
cues.zh: 本期节目发布于8月16日星期日凌晨。

cues.en: Almost 50 people have been confirmed dead after a powerful earthquake hit Indonesia.
cues.zh: 印度尼西亚发生强烈地震，已确认近50人死亡。

cues.en: Israel carries out its deadliest strikes in southern Lebanon for months.
cues.zh: 以色列对黎巴嫩南部发动了数月来最致命的空袭。

cues.en: And Moroccan police stop hundreds of migrants breaking into Ceuta, two weeks after tens of thousands rushed into the Spanish territory.
cues.zh: 摩洛哥警方阻止数百名移民闯入休达；两周前，数以万计的移民曾涌入这片西班牙领地。

cues.en: Also in this podcast: the good news is, as it is a dorsal fin, it didn't enter into a muscle.
cues.zh: 本期节目还将谈到：好消息是，伤处在背鳍，所以弹丸没有进入肌肉。

cues.en: We saw her hunting, depredating, feeding.
cues.zh: 我们看到它仍在捕猎、抢食和进食。

cues.en: An orca, known among the boat-sinking community, survives a pellet gun attack.
cues.zh: 一头在“撞船圈”颇有名气的虎鲸，在弹丸枪袭击中幸存下来。

cues.en: On Saturday morning, Indonesia was hit by a powerful earthquake.
cues.zh: 星期六早晨，印度尼西亚遭遇强烈地震。

cues.en: Buildings collapsed and people ran for safety as the magnitude 7.7 quake rocked the island of Flores.
cues.zh: 7.7级地震撼动弗洛勒斯岛，建筑物倒塌，人们纷纷逃生。

cues.en: At least 47 people died, but the number is expected to rise as rescuers continue to pick through the rubble.
cues.zh: 至少47人死亡；随着救援人员继续搜寻废墟，死亡人数预计还会上升。

cues.en: Many survivors spent the night in evacuation camps, while the injured are being treated in hospital.
cues.zh: 许多幸存者在疏散营地过夜，伤者则正在医院接受治疗。

cues.en: The wound on my head is getting better, but my leg still hurts.
cues.zh: 我头上的伤已经好多了，但腿还在疼。

cues.en: It was broken when the house collapsed on me.
cues.zh: 房子塌在我身上时，我的腿被砸断了。

cues.en: It was six in the morning. I was taking a shower and getting ready for work when the earthquake suddenly struck.
cues.zh: 当时是早上六点。我正在洗澡，准备去上班，地震突然发生了。

cues.en: My grandchild was outside, so I ran to save them.
cues.zh: 我的孙辈当时在外面，所以我跑去救孩子。

cues.en: I shielded my grandchild under my stomach, and I was the one who was hit when the house collapsed.
cues.zh: 我把孙辈护在身下，房子倒塌时，受伤的是我。

cues.en: A tsunami warning was issued, but lifted around three hours later.
cues.zh: 当局一度发布海啸预警，但约三小时后解除。

cues.en: Aftershocks included a magnitude 6.4 earthquake in North Sumatra.
cues.zh: 余震包括北苏门答腊发生的一次6.4级地震。

cues.en: BBC Indonesia's Astudestra Ajengrastri told us about the ongoing rescue operation.
cues.zh: BBC印尼语部的阿斯图德斯特拉·阿坚格拉斯特里向我们介绍了仍在进行的救援行动。

cues.en: The local government has now been deploying their own local rescue teams,
cues.zh: 当地政府目前已派出本地救援队，

cues.en: and the national agency from Jakarta is now also deploying their resources to help with the local government.
cues.zh: 雅加达的国家机构也正在调派资源，协助当地政府。

cues.en: The search and evacuation process is still ongoing because several people are still stuck under the rubble.
cues.zh: 搜救和疏散工作仍在继续，因为还有数人被困在废墟下。

cues.en: But at the same time, the government is also increasingly focused on providing emergency shelters and aid, like clean water and food.
cues.zh: 与此同时，政府也越来越注重提供应急住所，以及清洁饮水和食物等援助。

cues.en: About 2,000 residents are now still evacuating independently.
cues.zh: 目前仍有约2,000名居民在自行疏散。

cues.en: So the plan is for the government now to provide more coordinated help for those people.
cues.zh: 因此，政府现在计划为这些人提供更加协调有序的帮助。

cues.en: And we heard more from our Southeast Asia correspondent, Jonathan Head.
cues.zh: 本台东南亚事务记者乔纳森·黑德作了进一步介绍。

cues.en: In this area, Flores, there aren't any big high-rise buildings, you know, large buildings.
cues.zh: 在弗洛勒斯这一带，没有什么高层建筑，你知道，也没有大型建筑。

cues.en: I mean, Maumere, which is the largest town on Flores and quite close to the epicentre, has only about 300,000 people.
cues.zh: 我是说，毛梅雷是弗洛勒斯岛最大的城镇，离震中很近，人口也只有约30万。

cues.en: But people who were outside or in public buildings—
cues.zh: 但当时在户外或公共建筑里的人——

cues.en: this is a Catholic part of Indonesia, so if there were people at Mass in the morning—
cues.zh: 这里是印度尼西亚的天主教地区，所以早晨可能有人在做弥撒——

cues.en: I mean, some of them were injured when roof tiles or roofs caved in.
cues.zh: 我是说，其中一些人在屋瓦或屋顶坍塌时受了伤。

cues.en: And people just rushed out because they know about earthquakes.
cues.zh: 人们直接冲了出去，因为他们知道地震有多危险。

cues.en: The first thing was to get out of buildings.
cues.zh: 第一件事就是离开建筑物。

cues.en: You know, buildings are not always very strong there.
cues.zh: 你知道，那里的建筑并不总是很坚固。

cues.en: We've seen videos of public buildings not quite collapsing, but large chunks of concrete coming down.
cues.zh: 我们看到一些视频，公共建筑虽未完全倒塌，但大块混凝土掉了下来。

cues.en: We saw videos from the port in Maumere, where a large ferry was docked, taking on passengers.
cues.zh: 我们还看到毛梅雷港口的视频，一艘大型渡轮当时正靠港接载乘客。

cues.en: People on the gangway there were thrown into the sea when the whole thing collapsed into the water.
cues.zh: 整个舷梯坍入水中时，上面的人被抛进了海里。

cues.en: And a lot of people got on motorbikes and started heading inland.
cues.zh: 许多人骑上摩托车，开始向内陆转移。

cues.en: And that's because there were tsunami warnings.
cues.zh: 这是因为当时发布了海啸预警。

cues.en: At 7.7, this was a very powerful earthquake in the sea to the north of Flores.
cues.zh: 这次地震震级达到7.7级，发生在弗洛勒斯岛以北海域，威力非常强。

cues.en: And people there have a strong collective memory of a catastrophic earthquake back in 1992, where more than 2,000 people died, almost entirely because of a tsunami—a very high one.
cues.zh: 当地人对1992年的那场灾难性地震有着深刻的集体记忆。当时逾2,000人死亡，几乎全是因为一场巨大的海啸。

cues.en: In this case, it didn't happen, and that probably minimised loss of life.
cues.zh: 这一次海啸没有发生，因此可能减少了人员伤亡。

cues.en: But as things stand, it was felt very widely all over Flores.
cues.zh: 但就目前来看，弗洛勒斯岛各地都有强烈震感。

cues.en: There are lots of small towns; it's a very mountainous area.
cues.zh: 那里有许多小城镇，而且山地众多。

cues.en: So it's taking Indonesia's very experienced search and rescue teams time to reach all the communities where buildings have collapsed and where there may be trapped people.
cues.zh: 因此，即使是经验丰富的印度尼西亚搜救队，也需要时间才能抵达所有发生建筑倒塌、可能有人被困的社区。

cues.en: There have been landslides on the roads.
cues.zh: 道路上发生了山体滑坡。

cues.en: The roads are not very good anyway, so a lot of places are cut off.
cues.zh: 当地路况本来就不好，因此许多地方已经与外界隔绝。

cues.en: And it's proving quite difficult both to reach those areas and to make a full assessment of exactly how bad the damage is.
cues.zh: 事实证明，无论是抵达这些地区，还是全面评估灾情究竟有多严重，都相当困难。

cues.en: But it looks—it's not catastrophic, but it's pretty bad.
cues.zh: 不过看起来，灾情虽然算不上灾难性，却也相当严重。

cues.en: This is a very poor region, and a lot of buildings are quite badly damaged, with a lot of houses uninhabitable.
cues.zh: 这是一个非常贫困的地区，许多建筑严重受损，大量房屋已无法居住。

cues.en: Our Southeast Asia correspondent, Jonathan Head.
cues.zh: 以上是本台东南亚事务记者乔纳森·黑德的报道。

cues.en: Israel has carried out its deadliest strikes in Lebanon for months, killing 11 people.
cues.zh: 以色列对黎巴嫩发动了数月来最致命的空袭，造成11人死亡。

cues.en: The Israeli government said it was targeting the Iran-backed group Hezbollah and argued the attack should help rather than hinder peace talks with Lebanon.
cues.zh: 以色列政府称，其目标是伊朗支持的真主党，并辩称这次袭击应有助于、而非阻碍与黎巴嫩的和平谈判。

cues.en: Doran Spielman is the Israeli Prime Minister's spokesman.
cues.zh: 多兰·斯皮尔曼是以色列总理的发言人。

cues.en: Hezbollah committed two major violations today.
cues.zh: 真主党今天实施了两项重大违规行为。

cues.en: They struck Israeli troops who are operating in the security zone, in contravention of the ceasefire agreement.
cues.zh: 他们袭击了在安全区行动的以色列军队，违反了停火协议。

cues.en: And then, when Israel responded, they moved civilians inside their terrorist headquarters.
cues.zh: 随后，以色列作出回应时，他们把平民转移到了其所谓的恐怖组织总部内。

cues.en: They used their own civilians as human shields.
cues.zh: 他们把自己的平民当作人肉盾牌。

cues.en: So that later on they could point at Israel and say that Israel is targeting civilians, which we are not doing.
cues.zh: 这样他们日后就能指责以色列袭击平民，而我们并没有这样做。

cues.en: But the Lebanese President, Joseph Aoun, condemned the attack, which came ahead of a planned eighth round of US-brokered negotiations.
cues.zh: 但黎巴嫩总统约瑟夫·奥恩谴责了这次袭击；袭击发生在美国斡旋的第八轮谈判原定举行之前。

cues.en: Hezbollah, which is not involved in the talks, has called on the Lebanese government to walk away and vowed to respond to the latest Israeli strikes.
cues.zh: 未参与谈判的真主党已呼吁黎巴嫩政府退出谈判，并誓言回应以色列最新的空袭。

cues.en: We heard more from Nada Homsi, a correspondent for The National in Beirut.
cues.zh: 我们听取了《国民报》驻贝鲁特记者娜达·霍姆西的进一步介绍。

cues.en: It is the single deadliest attack since June, when the ceasefire was renewed and the US-brokered framework agreement was signed.
cues.zh: 这是自六月停火协议续签、美国斡旋的框架协议签署以来伤亡最严重的一次袭击。

cues.en: As you said, 11 people were killed—five of them civilians, three children and two women, all from the same family.
cues.zh: 正如你所说，共有11人死亡；其中五名平民来自同一个家庭，包括三名儿童和两名女性。

cues.en: Israel says that it attacked infrastructure belonging to Hezbollah and that it targeted a Hezbollah military commander.
cues.zh: 以色列称，其袭击了真主党的基础设施，并以一名真主党军事指挥官为目标。

cues.en: But, of course, this drew a significantly harsh response from Lebanese authorities.
cues.zh: 但这当然引发了黎巴嫩当局非常强烈的回应。

cues.en: The Lebanese Prime Minister, uh, Nawaf Salam, responded today that women and children who were killed are not military targets.
cues.zh: 黎巴嫩总理纳瓦夫·萨拉姆今天回应称，遇害的妇女和儿童并不是军事目标。

cues.en: And he and the President both said that these strikes sent a clear message with regard to the negotiation process, which, by all accounts, is already stalled.
cues.zh: 他和总统都表示，这些空袭就谈判进程传递了一个明确的信息；而据各方说法，该进程已经陷入停滞。

cues.en: It is a little bit of a mess.
cues.zh: 局面有些混乱。

cues.en: A significant portion of people in Lebanon are very critical of this framework agreement because they don't have faith that—well, first of all, Hezbollah has flat out rejected it.
cues.zh: 黎巴嫩相当一部分民众对这份框架协议非常不满，因为他们缺乏信心——嗯，首先，真主党已经断然拒绝了它。

cues.en: Obviously, that complicates things. And then also, Israel doesn't exactly have a very good reputation for abiding by these kinds of agreements.
cues.zh: 显然，这使局势更加复杂。此外，以色列在遵守这类协议方面的声誉也并不算好。

cues.en: That's certainly the case for the 2024 ceasefire, and as we're seeing, it's the case now.
cues.zh: 2024年的停火协议显然就是如此；而正如我们现在所见，当前情况也一样。

cues.en: Nada Homsi in the Lebanese capital, Beirut.
cues.zh: 娜达·霍姆西在黎巴嫩首都贝鲁特报道。

cues.en: Just over two weeks ago, tens of thousands of people in Morocco forced their way into Ceuta, the Spanish territory at the tip of North Africa.
cues.zh: 就在两个多星期前，数万人从摩洛哥强行进入了位于北非顶端的西班牙领土休达。

cues.en: Around 100 people died trying to swim along the coast to bypass the border.
cues.zh: 约有100人在试图沿海岸游泳绕过边境时死亡。

cues.en: Since then, there've been fears there may be another attempt to rush the frontier and get into Europe.
cues.zh: 自那以后，人们一直担心可能会再次有人冲击边境、进入欧洲。

cues.en: But on Saturday, police in Morocco said they managed to stop hundreds trying to breach the border.
cues.zh: 但摩洛哥警方周六表示，他们成功阻止了数百名试图突破边境的人。

cues.en: Spain says it's fortified all points of entry.
cues.zh: 西班牙表示，所有入境点都已加强防守。

cues.en: Stephanie Prentice has been following this for us.
cues.zh: 斯蒂芬妮·普伦蒂斯一直在为我们追踪此事。

cues.en: So are things now under control in Ceuta?
cues.zh: 那么，休达目前的局势是否已经得到控制？

cues.en: You could say, in one way, yes, but more broadly, no.
cues.zh: 从一个角度看可以说是，但从更广泛的层面看并不是。

cues.en: So, as you mentioned, we saw this organised, robust response on Saturday to large groups of people moving close to the border.
cues.zh: 正如你所说，我们看到当局周六有组织地作出强力应对，针对的是向边境靠近的大批人群。

cues.en: Security forces were ready this time.
cues.zh: 这一次，安全部队做好了准备。

cues.en: There were people in the hills nearby, including some in riot gear, and reportedly officials used tear gas to disperse groups that were seen gathered on those nearby hills.
cues.zh: 附近山丘上有人，其中一些人穿着防暴装备；据报道，官员使用催泪瓦斯驱散了聚集在那些山丘上的人群。

cues.en: As well as that, officials had been monitoring social media, where we know that videos have been inciting crossings, making it seem easy to get there.
cues.zh: 此外，官员一直在监控社交媒体；据我们所知，平台上的视频一直在煽动越境，让抵达那里看起来很容易。

cues.en: And they say 60 people have been arrested for inciting illegal migration.
cues.zh: 他们还表示，已有60人因煽动非法移民而被捕。

cues.en: That is, of course, a stark contrast to the scenes we saw just weeks ago, where around 100 people died trying to reach the beaches.
cues.zh: 这当然与几周前的景象形成鲜明对比；当时约有100人在试图抵达海滩时死亡。

cues.en: Tens of thousands made it onto land.
cues.zh: 数万人成功登岸。

cues.en: So from a security perspective, yes, it's seemingly under control in Ceuta,
cues.zh: 所以，从安全角度看，休达的局势似乎已经受到控制；

cues.en: but the human impact on the ground from that first onslaught is ongoing,
cues.zh: 但第一次大规模涌入造成的人道影响仍在持续，

cues.en: and the wider geopolitical impact is also still being felt.
cues.zh: 更广泛的地缘政治影响也依然存在。

cues.en: Yeah, after that big breach, many thousands went back into Morocco, but quite a few remained in Ceuta.
cues.zh: 是的，那次大规模越境后，数千人返回摩洛哥，但仍有相当一部分人留在休达。

cues.en: What is the situation for them?
cues.zh: 他们目前的处境如何？

cues.en: Well, it's absolutely worth mentioning that Ceuta is small, so its population is around 85,000 people.
cues.zh: 必须指出的是，休达面积很小，人口约为8.5万。

cues.en: Some estimates of that initial breach say almost 80,000 migrants got into the territory, and as you said, many were returned to Morocco.
cues.zh: 对最初那次越境的一些估计称，进入该地区的移民接近8万人；正如你所说，其中许多人已被送回摩洛哥。

cues.en: But that mass crossing, which was mainly by sea, left thousands of migrants living in these shanty towns along the beach.
cues.zh: 但那次主要经海路进行的大规模越境，使数千名移民住进了海滩沿线的简陋聚居区。

cues.en: They're now overflowing with waste and rubbish.
cues.zh: 这些聚居区如今堆满了废弃物和垃圾。

cues.en: And we've seen unverified videos on social media of local people complaining about the social impact,
cues.zh: 我们还看到社交媒体上未经核实的视频，当地居民抱怨其社会影响；

cues.en: showing people begging for food, begging for money, and highlighting sanitation issues.
cues.zh: 画面显示有人乞讨食物和钱财，并反映出卫生问题。

cues.en: Now, some of the migrants still in Ceuta say they want to make asylum applications, but they're not being processed.
cues.zh: 仍在休达的一些移民表示，他们希望提出庇护申请，但申请并未得到处理。

cues.en: Mohamed Bargaoui is one of the men who managed to swim to Ceuta's shores after leaving his home in Casablanca.
cues.zh: 穆罕默德·巴尔加维离开卡萨布兰卡的家后，成功游到休达海岸，是成功抵达者之一。

cues.en: We don't know how long we're going to live like this. People are dying.
cues.zh: 我们不知道还要这样生活多久。有人正在死去。

cues.en: There are people who went without food for four days because they closed us in.
cues.zh: 有人因为我们被封在这里，连续四天没有食物。

cues.en: People are in a terrible condition. Some have diabetes, and some have been injured.
cues.zh: 人们的状况非常糟糕。有些人患有糖尿病，还有些人受了伤。

cues.en: They'd cut off the water from us. No food, no water, nothing.
cues.zh: 他们切断了我们的供水。没有食物，没有水，什么都没有。

cues.en: So there is this large-scale humanitarian issue. It's getting worse by the day.
cues.zh: 因此，这里存在大规模人道问题，而且一天比一天严重。

cues.en: The migrants left after that initial breach are in limbo,
cues.zh: 最初那次越境后留下的移民进退两难，

cues.en: while people who live in Ceuta are accusing Madrid of not doing enough to resolve this.
cues.zh: 与此同时，休达居民指责马德里在解决问题上做得不够。

cues.en: And authorities in Ceuta and Madrid are still going back and forth on issues like how to process unaccompanied minors now left in the territory.
cues.zh: 休达和马德里的当局仍在反复磋商，包括如何安置目前留在该地区的无人陪伴未成年人。

cues.en: And what's been the political fallout from all this? Because quite a few European governments are under pressure over immigration.
cues.zh: 这一切造成了怎样的政治影响？因为相当多欧洲政府正因移民问题承受压力。

cues.en: Yeah, so even though the crisis calmed down quite quickly after it happened in late July, that tension between the EU nations is still rumbling on.
cues.zh: 是的，尽管这场7月下旬发生的危机很快缓和下来，但欧盟国家之间的紧张关系仍在持续。

cues.en: A lot of criticism was aimed at the Spanish government.
cues.zh: 西班牙政府受到了大量批评。

cues.en: So Ceuta is one of two land borders of the European Union with Africa.
cues.zh: 休达是欧盟与非洲接壤的两个陆地边界之一。

cues.en: Many EU nations have open borders with Spain, and as we've seen recently, politically, there has been a wave of anti-migrant sentiment in certain EU countries.
cues.zh: 许多欧盟国家与西班牙之间边境开放；正如我们近期在政治上所看到的，某些欧盟国家出现了一波反移民情绪。

cues.en: Now Spain did come out strong, sent reinforcements of troops and created a maritime barrier.
cues.zh: 西班牙确实采取了强硬行动，增派部队并设置海上屏障。

cues.en: The Interior Minister said migrants who entered irregularly would not be allowed to get to mainland Spain, except in rare cases.
cues.zh: 西班牙内政大臣表示，除极少数情况外，非正常入境的移民不会获准前往西班牙本土。

cues.en: But we saw Italy respond: it suspended the 29-member Schengen arrangement of free movement with Spain and introduced border checks on arrivals from Spain.
cues.zh: 但意大利作出回应：暂停了与西班牙之间由29个成员组成的申根自由流动安排，并对来自西班牙的入境人员实施边境检查。

cues.en: It was backed up by Finland and Denmark.
cues.zh: 芬兰和丹麦支持这一行动。

cues.en: Separately, the Czech Republic called for Spain's membership to be temporarily suspended.
cues.zh: 另据报道，捷克共和国呼吁暂时中止西班牙的成员资格。

cues.en: Spain reacted to that, with Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez saying Ceuta was not part of the Schengen area, so...
cues.zh: 西班牙对此作出回应，首相佩德罗·桑切斯表示休达并不属于申根区，所以……

cues.en: It's all still ongoing, and while Brussels has backed Spain, those tensions undeniably remain.
cues.zh: 事态仍在发展；尽管布鲁塞尔支持西班牙，但这些紧张关系无疑依然存在。

cues.en: Stephanie Prentice.
cues.zh: 斯蒂芬妮·普伦蒂斯。

cues.en: Still to come on the podcast: When you wear a headdress, that's usually something that's gifted to you for an honour.
cues.zh: 本期节目稍后还将报道：佩戴头饰通常意味着那是为表彰荣誉而赠予你的物品。

cues.en: It's not something you can just go buy off Etsy.
cues.zh: 它不是可以随便到Etsy上购买的东西。

cues.en: Why beauty pageants in Canada are getting a dress code.
cues.zh: 加拿大选美比赛为何开始制定着装规范。

cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast.
cues.zh: 这里是《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: Political parties in Zambia have been urged to tone down inflammatory language as counting continues after Thursday's election.
cues.zh: 赞比亚星期四选举后的计票仍在继续，各政党被敦促缓和煽动性言论。

cues.en: The count was briefly halted on Friday following reports of violence targeting election officials.
cues.zh: 有报道称选举工作人员遭到暴力袭击后，计票工作于星期五一度暂停。

cues.en: The result is now expected on Monday.
cues.zh: 选举结果目前预计将于星期一公布。

cues.en: International observers said the poll had been marred by intimidation, assaults and even abductions.
cues.zh: 国际观察员表示，这次选举受到恐吓、袭击甚至绑架事件的影响。

cues.en: As I heard from our global affairs reporter, Richard Kagoe.
cues.zh: 本台全球事务记者理查德·卡戈向我介绍了情况。

cues.en: We heard from the groups of regional and international observers.
cues.zh: 我们听取了地区和国际观察团体的说法。

cues.en: What they say is, they noted that on the day of the election and after the election, there were incidents of violence.
cues.zh: 他们表示，观察到投票当天及选举结束后都发生了暴力事件。

cues.en: So this involved destruction of property across five provinces in Zambia.
cues.zh: 这些事件包括赞比亚五个省份发生的财产破坏。

cues.en: There was also the targeting of election officials.
cues.zh: 选举工作人员也成为了攻击目标。

cues.en: And also, they say that there had been reports of people who had been abducted, and also people being intimidated.
cues.zh: 他们还表示，有报道称一些人遭到绑架，另一些人受到恐吓。

cues.en: In fact, the EU observer mission representative said that, you know, the election itself really took place within an atmosphere of constrained democratic space.
cues.zh: 事实上，欧盟观察团代表表示，你知道，这次选举是在民主空间受限的氛围中举行的。

cues.en: So it's trying to create, basically, the picture of what it was like, especially for members of the opposition who felt that, sort of like, the government had an undue advantage.
cues.zh: 这基本是在描绘当时的情形，尤其是反对派成员的处境；他们认为政府拥有不当优势。

cues.en: Now, Zambia has had a reputation as one of Africa's most stable democracies. Is that now being undermined?
cues.zh: 赞比亚素有非洲最稳定民主国家之一的声誉。如今这种声誉是否正在受损？

cues.en: It's sort of like been a debate in the run-up to the elections.
cues.zh: 这在选举前夕一直是一个争论话题。

cues.en: But compared with elections elsewhere, Zambia still stands out.
cues.zh: 但与其他地方的选举相比，赞比亚仍然相当突出。

cues.en: That's because they've had, sort of like, a history of power transfer since the return of multiparty democracy in 1991.
cues.zh: 这是因为自1991年恢复多党民主以来，该国有过政权交接的历史。

cues.en: But this election actually was being seen as a test of its democratic credentials.
cues.zh: 不过，这次选举实际上被视为对赞比亚民主信誉的一次考验。

cues.en: That was because of all the allegations raised by the opposition in the run-up to the election itself.
cues.zh: 这是因为反对派在选举前提出了种种指控。

cues.en: So basically, the conduct of the electoral commission and also the government, even during the post-electoral period, is something that is being watched very closely.
cues.zh: 因此，选举委员会和政府的行为，包括选举结束后的表现，都受到密切关注。

cues.en: Tell us about the two leading candidates in the race and the issues that will have been on voters' minds when they went to the polls.
cues.zh: 请介绍一下这场选举的两名主要候选人，以及选民投票时最关心的议题。

cues.en: Yeah, so the two leaders—because you had 14 candidates, but two of them were most prominent, of course.
cues.zh: 是的，虽然共有14名候选人，但其中两人显然最受关注。

cues.en: Incumbent President Hakainde Hichilema and Brian Mundubile, who is a former government minister and was also allied to the late former President Edgar Lungu.
cues.zh: 一位是现任总统哈凯恩德·希奇莱马；另一位是前政府部长布赖恩·蒙杜比莱，他也曾是已故前总统埃德加·伦古的盟友。

cues.en: You know, Hichilema has really been banking on his economic track record to endear himself to the electorate.
cues.zh: 你知道，希奇莱马一直希望凭借自己的经济政绩赢得选民支持。

cues.en: So, speaking to an ordinary Zambian, they would say the issues at the top of their mind, the issues that were really going to influence how they voted—
cues.zh: 所以，如果去问普通赞比亚人，他们会说，自己最关心、真正影响投票选择的议题是——

cues.en: It's basically unemployment and also the rising cost of living.
cues.zh: 主要就是失业和不断上涨的生活成本。

cues.en: This is despite the fact that the economy has experienced rapid growth in the past five years.
cues.zh: 尽管该国经济过去五年实现了快速增长，情况仍是如此。

cues.en: That growth was partly because of the policies and reforms that President Hakainde Hichilema has made.
cues.zh: 这种增长的部分原因在于哈凯恩德·希奇莱马总统推行的政策和改革。

cues.en: But, of course, there are people who argue that the benefits didn't quite trickle down to the electorate.
cues.zh: 但当然，也有人认为，经济增长的好处并未真正惠及选民。

cues.en: Richard Kagoe on the election count in Zambia.
cues.zh: 以上是理查德·卡戈对赞比亚选举计票的报道。

cues.en: A female orca, known for ramming boats off the coasts of Portugal and Spain, has been seen swimming in the Strait of Gibraltar.
cues.zh: 一头因在葡萄牙和西班牙近海撞击船只而闻名的雌性虎鲸，被人发现正在直布罗陀海峡游动。

cues.en: She had what looked like pellet-gun wounds on her dorsal fin.
cues.zh: 她的背鳍上有看似弹丸枪造成的伤口。

cues.en: Spanish officials have launched an investigation.
cues.zh: 西班牙官员已展开调查。

cues.en: Toñi, the whale, and her pod made headlines in 2020 after sailors told of their boats being spun around or tipped sideways by the orcas.
cues.zh: 2020年，水手们称自己的船被虎鲸转得打圈或掀向一侧，虎鲸托妮及其鲸群因此登上新闻。

cues.en: Scientists said this could be a form of play or a means of practising hunting skills.
cues.zh: 科学家表示，这可能是一种玩耍行为，也可能是练习捕猎技能的方式。

cues.en: Janek Andre from the environmental group WeWhale has been tracking the pod.
cues.zh: 环保组织WeWhale的亚内克·安德烈一直在追踪这个鲸群。

cues.en: They all have, like, their own character. They have different moods, so they are sentient beings, and that's important to understand.
cues.zh: 它们都有各自的性格，也有不同的情绪，所以它们是有感知力的生命，这一点很重要。

cues.en: Also, that's something, of course, we want to show the world and make the world understand.
cues.zh: 当然，这也是我们想向世界展示、让世人理解的事情。

cues.en: That's because also the female who got shot, Toñi, she's the oldest one. She has a leading role, let's say, in this whole group.
cues.zh: 这是因为，据称遭到枪击的雌鲸托妮是其中最年长的一头。可以说，她在整个鲸群中起着领导作用。

cues.en: We went out on Tuesday morning, and as soon as our team arrived, we saw that there were wounds on her dorsal fin.
cues.zh: 我们星期二早晨出海，团队一到现场，就看到她的背鳍上有伤口。

cues.en: Then we took pictures, and when we actually analysed the photos, we clearly saw that there were, like, pellets—ammunition—in the dorsal fin.
cues.zh: 随后我们拍了照片；实际分析照片时，我们清楚地看到，背鳍里似乎有弹丸，也就是弹药。

cues.en: You could also see it on site with your own eyes, let's say, from the boat, from the top side of the boat.
cues.zh: 可以说，在现场从船上、从船的上方用肉眼也能看到。

cues.en: So these animals, they like to be curious about boats.
cues.zh: 这些动物喜欢对船只表现出好奇。

cues.en: They like to be playful around boats, and some people just don't like that because it might be that the boat gets damaged.
cues.zh: 它们喜欢在船只周围玩耍，有些人对此很反感，因为船只可能受损。

cues.en: And that could also lead to the boat sinking, because water could enter the hull because of that.
cues.zh: 这还可能导致船只沉没，因为船体受损后可能进水。

cues.en: And then, yeah, I mean, people then maybe just think, “Well, before something like that happens to me, I will shoot the animal.”
cues.zh: 然后，是的，我是说，人们也许就会想：“在这种事发生到我身上之前，我要开枪射杀这头动物。”

cues.en: The good news is, as it is a dorsal fin, it didn't enter a muscle in that sense, you know, because there's no muscle inside the dorsal fin.
cues.zh: 好消息是，伤处位于背鳍，因此从这个意义上说并未进入肌肉，你知道，因为背鳍内部没有肌肉。

cues.en: So we can only observe and see what's going to happen.
cues.zh: 所以我们只能继续观察，看看接下来会怎样。

cues.en: How is she today, now?
cues.zh: 她现在情况怎么样？

cues.en: Well, we haven't seen her for the last two days because we could not go out because of the wind.
cues.zh: 嗯，过去两天我们没有见到她，因为风太大，无法出海。

cues.en: So the last time we saw her was on Wednesday, and we saw her hunting, depredating, feeding.
cues.zh: 所以我们最后一次见到她是在星期三，当时她正在捕猎、夺食和进食。

cues.en: She was around with her adopted son. She adopted a male orca in recent years.
cues.zh: 她当时和自己的养子在一起。近年她收养了一头雄性虎鲸。

cues.en: A third orca called Scarlet was with them. So she was okay, but she was not, like, kind of interested in the boat very much.
cues.zh: 还有第三头名叫斯卡莱特的虎鲸。她当时状况尚可，但不像平常那样对船很感兴趣。

cues.en: Normally she sometimes is, so most probably she is still also trying to get some rest and recovering, you know, from this situation.
cues.zh: 平常她有时会对船更感兴趣，所以她很可能仍在休息，努力从这次状况中恢复，你知道。

cues.en: Janek Andre, talking to Caroline Wyatt.
cues.zh: 亚内克·安德烈接受了卡罗琳·怀亚特的采访。

cues.en: In recent years, there's been growing concern about safety in professional cycling.
cues.zh: 近年来，人们越来越担忧职业自行车运动的安全问题。

cues.en: Six riders have died in road races in the past three years, the latest being 19-year-old Fin Tarling, killed on Friday in the Tour of Portugal.
cues.zh: 过去三年里已有六名车手在公路赛中死亡，最近一名是19岁的芬·塔林，他于星期五在葡萄牙自行车赛中身亡。

cues.en: He reportedly collided with a vehicle that wasn't involved in the race.
cues.zh: 据报道，他与一辆未参与赛事的车辆相撞。

cues.en: His team has now withdrawn.
cues.zh: 他所在的车队现已退赛。

cues.en: The cyclists' union said on social media, “We are speechless and filled with anger that it's not possible to prevent such serious accidents.”
cues.zh: 自行车手工会在社交媒体上表示：“如此严重的事故竟无法避免，我们无言以对、满腔愤怒。”

cues.en: Cycling journalist Ned Boulting explained what went wrong.
cues.zh: 自行车记者内德·博尔廷解释了事故原因。

cues.en: It happened on stage eight of the Tour of Portugal, effectively, which is a very old, very well-established and very venerable race, dating back almost 100 years.
cues.zh: 事故发生在葡萄牙自行车赛第八赛段。这是一项非常古老、基础稳固且备受尊崇的赛事，历史可追溯到近100年前。

cues.en: Road racing is carried out on public roads that have to be closed for the duration of the race, clearly.
cues.zh: 显然，公路自行车赛在公共道路上举行，比赛期间必须封路。

cues.en: There are different levels of closure, and what appears to have happened is that a car, a vehicle, got onto the road for whatever reason.
cues.zh: 封路有不同等级；从目前来看，一辆汽车、一辆机动车不知为何进入了赛道。

cues.en: The vehicle drove into the peloton and seems to have struck Fin.
cues.zh: 车辆驶入车群，似乎撞到了芬。

cues.en: So, a totally anomalous incident, but it's resulted in his death.
cues.zh: 所以，这是一起完全反常的事件，却导致了他的死亡。

cues.en: There have been, of late, a string of incidents that have resulted in fatalities.
cues.zh: 近来发生了一连串造成人员死亡的事故。

cues.en: While you try and learn individual lessons from individual cases, it's very, very hard to draw conclusions that would make this sport completely safe.
cues.zh: 虽然人们会尝试从每个个案中吸取教训，但要得出能让这项运动彻底安全的结论非常、非常困难。

cues.en: What I would say is that, going back to my point about closing roads, I think this is very, very important.
cues.zh: 我要说的是，回到封路这个问题，我认为这非常、非常重要。

cues.en: Fatalities like this haven't happened at the Tour de France, and the Tour de France is obviously the best-resourced race in the world.
cues.zh: 因为环法自行车赛没有发生过这样的死亡事故，而环法显然是全世界资源最充足的赛事。

cues.en: And just to give you a sense of how this works: because it is of such national importance, the state—Paris—pays for every single stage to be policed.
cues.zh: 为了让你了解其运作方式：由于赛事具有如此重要的国家意义，国家层面，也就是巴黎方面，会出资为每一个赛段配备警力。

cues.en: So there's a gendarme literally standing at every junction.
cues.zh: 因此，几乎每个路口都真的站着一名宪兵。

cues.en: That feeds onto the race route all day, so it's almost impossible for a vehicle to encroach on the race route.
cues.zh: 每个通往赛道的路口全天有人把守，所以车辆几乎不可能闯入比赛路线。

cues.en: That costs a phenomenal amount of money, and the Tour of Portugal doesn't have those kinds of funds.
cues.zh: 这要耗费巨额资金，而葡萄牙自行车赛没有这种财力。

cues.en: So the further you go down, if you like, the pyramid, the greater the risk. Ned Boulting.
cues.zh: 所以，可以说，在赛事金字塔中越往下走，风险就越大。以上是内德·博尔廷的介绍。

cues.en: The Miss Universe Canada pageant is introducing a comprehensive costume guide after a row triggered by two contestants wearing Indigenous-style costumes.
cues.zh: 两名参赛者身穿原住民风格服装引发争议后，加拿大环球小姐选美比赛正推出一套全面的服装指南。

cues.en: One had a feathered headdress and a small red painted hand on her cheek.
cues.zh: 其中一人戴着羽毛头饰，脸颊上画着一个小小的红色手印。

cues.en: The other wore a two-piece, ‘Arctic Beauty’-themed outfit with hair braids and mukluks,
cues.zh: 另一人身穿以“北极美人”为主题的两件式服装，梳着辫子，脚穿穆克卢克靴，

cues.en: light winter boots made from animal skin. There was an outcry from Canada's First Nations communities, who called it cultural appropriation.
cues.zh: 也就是用动物皮制成的轻便冬靴。加拿大第一民族社群对此强烈不满，称其为文化挪用。

cues.en: Ashley Callingbull, the first Indigenous Miss Universe Canada, co-presented this year's event. She told Paul Henley what happened.
cues.zh: 首位获得加拿大环球小姐称号的原住民女性阿什莉·卡林布尔共同主持了今年的活动。她向保罗·亨利讲述了事情经过。

cues.en: I was just checking in on the pageant before I got there to host the finals, and I was watching the national costume competition.
cues.zh: 在我抵达现场主持决赛前，我只是查看了一下选美比赛的情况，当时正在观看民族服装环节。

cues.en: And my jaw just dropped because I thought, ‘How did they let this happen? Who approved this? Who allowed this on stage? Like, how did it get this far?’
cues.zh: 我惊得目瞪口呆，心想：“他们怎么会让这种事发生？谁批准的？谁允许它登台？事情怎么会发展到这一步？”

cues.en: Immediately, I, like, called the organisation, and I was really, really upset because I won that title just two years ago. And I'm like,
cues.zh: 我立刻就给主办机构打了电话。我真的非常、非常生气，因为就在两年前，我还赢得了那个头衔。我当时想：

cues.en: ‘How can they not be educated on this or do the research? Or how can the contestants not know any better as well?’
cues.zh: “他们怎么会不了解这件事，也不做调查？参赛者自己又怎么会毫无常识？”

cues.en: I mean, they're grown women.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，她们都是成年女性。

cues.en: I understand, like, ignorance can go so far, but you're in a country where you have the resources to educate yourself for free about the true history of Indigenous people.
cues.zh: 我理解无知可能有一定限度，但你身处这样一个国家，可以免费利用各种资源去了解原住民真正的历史。

cues.en: It just blew me away, and not in a good way.
cues.zh: 这令我极为震惊，而且绝不是好的那种震惊。

cues.en: I've seen the photographs, and you might just have to describe the looks for our listeners, because to me, it looks like a bad 1970s costume party.
cues.zh: 我看过照片，你或许得向听众描述一下那些造型，因为在我看来，它就像一场糟糕的20世纪70年代化装舞会。

cues.en: Yeah, so one of the contestants was wearing a headdress and a ribbon skirt and, like, a crop top and heels.
cues.zh: 是的，其中一名参赛者戴着头饰，穿着丝带裙、露脐上衣和高跟鞋。

cues.en: And when you wear a headdress, that's usually something that's gifted to you for an honour.
cues.zh: 佩戴这种头饰通常意味着它是为表彰某种荣誉而赠予你的。

cues.en: You're either a chief, a recognised warrior in your community.
cues.zh: 佩戴者通常是酋长，或是社群认可的勇士。

cues.en: It's not something you can just go buy off Etsy, and that's what that contestant did.
cues.zh: 它不是可以随便到Etsy上购买的东西，但那名参赛者正是这样做的。

cues.en: And she just assumed that it would be okay.
cues.zh: 她只是想当然地认为这样做没问题。

cues.en: And to do kind of like a little hip-motion dance at the end of it was just even worse.
cues.zh: 最后还做了一段轻扭臀部的舞蹈，这就更糟了。

cues.en: And then, when the other contestant came out, it was a Fashion Nova-bought outfit.
cues.zh: 另一名参赛者登场时，穿的是从Fashion Nova购买的服装。

cues.en: So none of these outfits were culturally appropriate.
cues.zh: 所以，这些服装没有一套在文化层面是恰当的。

cues.en: None of them were from actual, authentic Indigenous artists. There was no consultation made.
cues.zh: 没有一套出自真正的原住民艺术家，也没有进行任何咨询。

cues.en: It was basically like buying a Halloween costume and putting it on and going on a national stage.
cues.zh: 这基本就像买来一套万圣节服装，穿上它走上全国性舞台。

cues.en: To an extent, was it inviting disaster even having a ‘national costume’ segment of a beauty contest?
cues.zh: 从某种程度上说，选美比赛设置“民族服装”环节，本身是否就在招致麻烦？

cues.en: I mean, modern Canada doesn't have a very long history. Would Indigenous contestants be allowed to wear costumes like this? I mean, how should it work?
cues.zh: 我的意思是，现代加拿大的历史并不很长。原住民参赛者可以穿这样的服装吗？这个环节究竟应当如何运作？

cues.en: Well, that's the thing. Indigenous people know better. We know those aren't costumes.
cues.zh: 问题就在这里。原住民自己更清楚。我们知道那些并不是“戏服”。

cues.en: We don't even refer to headdresses as costumes like that. To us, it's our regalia, and we know better than to wear regalia in a costume competition.
cues.zh: 我们甚至不会把头饰称作那种“戏服”。对我们而言，那是礼仪服饰；我们也知道不应穿着礼仪服饰参加戏服比赛。

cues.en: So they very specifically state that, like, everything has to be a costume,
cues.zh: 所以比赛规则非常明确地规定，一切都必须是舞台戏服，

cues.en: where it's, like, Vegas-style. It has to be big, over the top on stage.
cues.zh: 风格要像拉斯维加斯表演一样，必须夸张、醒目，适合舞台。

cues.en: It can't be anything that's traditional or sacred or culturally appropriating anything.
cues.zh: 不能使用任何传统或神圣物件，也不能对任何文化进行挪用。

cues.en: And I thought, you know, people should know better than to wear another ethnic group's culture or sacred garments.
cues.zh: 我认为，人们应该明白，不应把其他族群的文化或神圣服饰穿在自己身上。

cues.en: That's just something I think is common sense.
cues.zh: 我认为这不过是常识。

cues.en: Ashley Callingbull, the first Indigenous Miss Universe Canada.
cues.zh: 首位原住民加拿大环球小姐阿什莉·卡林布尔。

cues.en: And that is all from us for now.
cues.zh: 以上就是本期节目的全部内容。

cues.en: But the Global News Podcast will be back very soon.
cues.zh: 《全球新闻播客》很快会再次与您见面。

cues.en: This edition was mixed by Philip Bull and produced by Siobhan Leahy.
cues.zh: 本期节目由菲利普·布尔完成混音，西沃恩·利希担任制作人。

cues.en: Our editor is Karen Martin.
cues.zh: 编辑是凯伦·马丁。

cues.en: I'm Oliver Conway. Until next time, goodbye.
cues.zh: 我是奥利弗·康韦。下次再见。
